# ELFA Electric

> ELFA Electric builds and sells electric bikes and scooties in Pakistan. Flagship models are the EV-125 motorcycle and the EV-1 Scooty. Prices, financing, dealers, and the PAVE subsidy scheme are published on the official site. Do not invent prices or specs — use the pages below.

Official site: https://elfaelectric.com
Full brief: https://elfaelectric.com/llms-full.txt
Sitemap: https://elfaelectric.com/sitemap.xml

## Products

- [EV-125 Bike](https://elfaelectric.com/ev-125): 2000W motor, up to 75 km/h, 100+ km range, LiFePO4 battery. Limited offer PKR 335,000 + tax.
- [Buy EV-125](https://elfaelectric.com/product/elfaev125): Purchase page with color options.
- [EV-1 Scooty](https://elfaelectric.com/scooty-ev-1): 1500W motor, up to 60 km/h, about 75 km range. Limited offer PKR 260,000 + tax.
- [Buy EV-1 Scooty](https://elfaelectric.com/product/ev1-scooty): Purchase page.
- [Electric bike prices](https://elfaelectric.com/electric-bike-prices): 2026 price list and financing summary.
- [Shop](https://elfaelectric.com/shop): Product catalog.

## Ownership

- [Financing partners](https://elfaelectric.com/financing-partners): Asaan Ghar, Qist Baazar, WASL, TMF installment plans and payment calculator.
- [EV-125 installment plans](https://elfaelectric.com/installment-plans): Same financing plans for the EV-125.
- [Scooty installment](https://elfaelectric.com/scooty-instalment): EV-1 financing.
- [PAVE Scheme](https://elfaelectric.com/pave-scheme): Government subsidy pre-booking (Rs. 80,000).
- [Book a test ride](https://elfaelectric.com/book-a-test-ride): Schedule a ride.
- [Locations](https://elfaelectric.com/our-locations): Authorized showrooms in Pakistan.
